choices.reason: No rule separates the candidates: the paper names no primary pairwise novelty contrast, and its main finding concerns LLM use versus MANUAL. All three are full-sample comparisons from the same session with no participant-level effect statistics or data_stats; FREE-FORM occurs in two candidates, while DIRECT and STRUCTURED both use constrained interfaces, so the chatbot preference does not identify a unique pair.
choices.locator: PDF p. 1, Abstract (quoted); p. 2, Section 1; p. 4, Section 3.1; pp. 7-9, Sections 4.5 and 5-5.2; p. 17, Appendix A.
choices.quote: To this end, we compared three ways of using LLMs (𝑁= 280): 1) free-form, 2) direct generation, and 3) a structured approach informed by a theory of reframing.
